title: Build D2 documentation diagram pipeline and educational landing page
description: Define a documented D2-based diagram generation pipeline, publish conceptual and AWS deployment diagrams in the README and website documentation, and redesign the landing page around data control, open-model choice, cost control, local GPU generation, and AWS fallback. Do not represent secure-by-design controls as final; add a clear placeholder structure for that evolving material.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Milestone update: D2 diagram pipeline, visual documentation, system light/dark design, and mobile overflow regression coverage are in the product PR. The task remains in progress until the product change lands on develop.

right_now_summary: The product PR adds the D2 pipeline, documentation, landing page, theme support, and mobile regression tests.
